bias.en: Downtrend · lost the 200-day, MACD and SAR turned down
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 200 日均线，MACD 与 SAR 同步转空

read.en: AMD fell 13.2% on Nov 20 to $424.39, its lowest close since Nov 5, trading $418.76–474.79 on heavy volume (1.76x the 20-day average). It fell below the rising 200-day ($429.8) and is under the 5-day ($490.3, falling), 10-day ($514.8, rising), 30-day ($523.1) and 100-day ($524.8), both falling. MACD crossed below its signal on Nov 20, below zero; Parabolic SAR turned bearish the same day ($594), and RSI is 38.4.
read.zh: AMD 11月20日下跌 13.2%，收于 $424.39，为 11月5日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $418.76–474.79，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 1.76 倍）。股价跌破上行的 200 日均线（$429.8），位于 5 日（$490.3，下行）、10 日（$514.8，上行）、30 日（$523.1）和 100 日均线（$524.8）下方，后两者均在下行。MACD 于 11月20日下穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 同日转为看空（$594），RSI 为 38.4。

read.en: The drop broke the $460–485 supports (Nov 17 and 19 lows, Nov 6 high) and the 200-day, now resistance. Resistance is $429.8 (200-day), then $437–440.5 (Jun 9 and Sep 3 lows) and $451–463 (August lows). Support is $418.8–424 (Nov 20 and Jul 29 lows), then $402–404 (Nov 5 low and close) and $393.4. A close above $440.5 would target $451–463; below $418.8, $402–404.
